instructions: This is a provenance record for the sealed authored Old City programme. Runtime playback does not read feedUrl, refreshSeconds or mediaUrl from this file.

Every default-world screen resolves only the packaged TikTok catalogue and the bundled archive clips below. Native cache files, account refreshes, direct HTTPS media and player manifests are never accepted as substitutes.
Creator profile links and official embeds remain available through creator-feeds.html, but they do not alter any in-game display.
The native city network shares at most three VideoPlayers. Photo posts use existing channel textures and audio sources. Do not put credentials in StreamingAssets.

The In-Q-Tel archive features 1984DRH and Hood Rich Records but was posted by @machine_publishers. Current TikTok metadata attributes the duet to @1984drh; its original @beef_talko sourceUrl is preserved as historical retrieval provenance.
